blocks.text: Thank you for turning the note around so quickly. Your edit to the closing paragraph is in, and the note is now final. It can go out from your address whenever suits you, and I will follow up with each person to book a time once it has.

On sitting in on the calls, we recommend against it. Investors speak more freely to an outside firm when no one from {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}} is on the line. You will still see every theme that comes out of the conversations, without names attached.
The next step is yours. Please send the note and copy me on it, so I know when to start booking.
